summary: Ideal Power Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 3,220,961 common shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 2,070,044 shares. The public offering price is $5.67 per share and $5.669 per pre-funded warrant, for total proceeds of approximately $29.998 million. The placement agent is Titan Partners Group LLC, receiving a 7.0% cash fee. The offering closes on or about May 18, 2026. This is a routine capital raise under an effective shelf registration; it does not constitute a special situation.
